# Enum types and CHECK lists of the DDL

Sources: `migrations/shard`, `migrations/catalog`; register N113, N137, N139, N187.

Closed sets of the schema: `CREATE TYPE ... AS ENUM` types and `CHECK (column IN (...))` constraints, as the migrations
define them. A CHECK that also allows NULL is marked `or NULL`.
